items.title: Loren Schoenberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2019
items.q: The interviewer mentions being in a car with Milt Hinton; the interviewee (Loren Schoenberg) responds by discussing his own childhood experiences and volunteering at the New York Jazz Museum, but does not claim to have met, played with, or had a personal relationship with Milt Hinton.

ctx.x: That’s the way I feel about it. Because you can’t pay for that stuff that you got.

Absolutely. A question you asked a while ago was like did I realize or did I know like you mentioned you were in a car with Milt Hinton over here asleep on your shoulder. You’re saying now wait a minute, this is not just some old bass player, this is Milton J. Hinton and this is Fiddler Claude Williams or these people. And the only way to answer your question is you know you were older when that happened to you, I assume you were in your 30s or something.
